editorial.blurb: Tesfa serves deeply flavored, house-made Ethiopian stews and injera that transport you straight to the heart of the cuisine—warm, welcoming, and worth the wait.
editorial.insiderTip: Come hungry and order a combination platter (portions scale with party size); arrive patient, as the kitchen simmers everything fresh, taking 20-30 minutes, but the sambusas make a great opener.
signatureDishes: vegetarian and meat/fish dishes with injera
